# Diana Simpson-Hernandez

> Designer, educator, innovator and founder based in London. Author of Design Poiesis, a design methodology for the age of AI. Founder and CEO of Aletheai (behavioural decision intelligence). Lecturer at IED Madrid; mentor at London College of Communication (UAL). FRSA, AFHEA.

Design Poiesis is a design methodology for the age of AI: five moves, two rails and a gate that turn informed intuition into design claims you can trace and test. It is a design hypothesis, to be tested.

## Core pages
- [Design Poiesis](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/design-poiesis/): the method in full
- [Methods](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/methods/): LEVER, RECALL, STAKE, FLYWHEEL, Vibecoding
- [Tools](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/tools/): HANDOVER and strategy canvases
- [Aletheai](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/aletheai/): behavioural decision intelligence
- [Research and writing](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/writing/): essays, papers and a book
- [Teaching and talks](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/teaching/)
- [Contact](https://dianasimpsonhernandez.com/contact/)
